name: Konstantinos Arvanitis - § 77 - Am 3
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 77. Strongly condemns any attempt by EU institutions to control political discourse on social media through the Digital Services Act (DSA); expresses grave concern that content moderation practices and the use of politically biased fact checkers undermine democratic debate and contribute to self-censorship; calls on the Commission to substantially amend the DSA with a view to restoring Member States’ primary responsibility over legal content and ensuring full respect for freedom of expression, the right to information and political pluralism;
